description: Every Meraki Dashboard operation, plus cross-org fleet views that read every page, built for MSPs running many client orgs.

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One worst-first row per client org with online, alerting, offline and dormant device counts, failed WAN uplinks, active alerts, and whether the org is reachable at all.

novel_features.name: Down-now list
novel_features.description: Every offline or alerting device and every failed MX WAN uplink across all orgs, with org and network names and, for offline devices, how long since the device last reported.

novel_features.name: Renewals radar
novel_features.description: License expirations (co-term, per-device or subscription, whichever each org uses) and end-of-sale and end-of-support hardware dates in one date-sorted list.

novel_features.name: Cross-org change log
novel_features.description: Configuration changes from every org in one list, filterable by admin, org, network and page, with old and new values.

novel_features.name: Entity resolver
novel_features.description: Paste a MAC, IP, serial, network ID or name and get the org and network that own the matching device, inventory entry, MX uplink or, by MAC, client.

novel_features.name: Cross-org fan-out with provenance
novel_features.description: Run any organization-scoped read against every org, fully paginated, with observed-at, item count, completeness and next-cursor metadata per org.

novel_features.name: Fleet push
novel_features.description: Apply one settings change to many networks across orgs through action batches: it previews a per-network current-versus-new diff by default and sends batches only with --apply.

novel_features.name: Admin access audit
novel_features.description: Dashboard admins across every org grouped by email, flagging missing two-factor auth, API key holders and stale access, with an offboarding view per person.

novel_features.name: Flap and downtime history
novel_features.description: Devices ranked by minutes offline, then by number of status changes, over a window of up to 31 days, across every org.

novel_features.name: Change-to-outage correlation
novel_features.description: For one network ID or device serial: each time it went offline or started alerting within --since (default 7 days, up to 31), the configuration changes made on that network just before.
